headline: Strong topline momentum; Profitability set to rebound

highlights: Q 2F Y2 7 performance : Amber reported mixed result with strong revenue growth (60% YoY, -32% QoQ) but profitability remaining under pressure.
EBITDA came at ₹98.3 crore with EBITDA margins at 3.7% down 180 bps YoY and 428 bps QoQ owing to select one-offs as well as commodity inflation.

Investment Rationale: • Diversification from RAC business shall be key growth driver : Amber’s strong revenue growth was driven by both Consumer Durables (+41% YoY) and Electronics divisions (+94% YoY).
Electronics division is expected to sustain strong growth momentum, while the Consumer durables segment is likely to grow in high teens, broadly in line with the industry.
